hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/vault"; [ -d "$d/.git" ] && git -C "$d" pull --rebase --autostash -q > /dev/null 2>&1; [ -f "$d/USER.md" ] && { echo 'vault/USER.md, who the user is and their goals:'; cat "$d/USER.md"; echo; }; [ -f "$d/index.md" ] && { echo 'vault/index.md, the vault recall surface:'; cat "$d/index.md"; } || true
